title: SIR: Synergy via Isotonic Regression
description: A nonparametric R package for drug-combination synergy testing. SIR defines interaction as the deviation from a monotone-additive null fit by 2D isotonic regression, and returns a calibrated per-matrix p-value via a degrees-of-freedom-corrected wild bootstrap, together with the interaction surface and effect size. Reference implementations of the Bliss, HSA, Loewe, and ZIP baselines are included for comparison.
